$comment: Doc-gallery manifest consumed by scripts/render-docs.mjs. `source` is resolved against docs/gallery-sources/ then tests/fixtures/. `engine` is 'elk' (default) or 'viz'. `packagesMatching` keeps only packages whose id matches the regex (and their entities/relations). `view`, `detail`, `memberMaxRows` and `memberMaxChars` are forwarded to renderDetailed unchanged. Figures are grouped into the gallery under their `section`, in first-seen order.

figures.title: Minimal class diagram
figures.caption: Three-compartment class/interface boxes, one package, and implementation (`..|>`), composition (`*--`) and dependency (`..>`) edges.

figures.title: Small class diagram
figures.caption: A small real ArchGuard class diagram (≤25 entities) with package grouping and orthogonal edges.

figures.title: Focused neighborhood view
figures.caption: The 1-hop neighborhood of one class carved out of the 70-entity architecture graph (`view: { kind: 'neighborhood' }`), with member rows capped (`memberMaxRows` / `memberMaxChars`) so boxes stay compact. Readable at README width, unlike the full graph below.

figures.title: Medium architecture view
figures.caption: A medium architecture diagram (25–70 entities): packages, package-level corridors and bundled arrowheads.

figures.title: Large package slice
figures.caption: A 100–200 entity slice of a 660-entity graph, through the same full-graph pipeline (hub summarisation included).
